catalog_quote: Baima is a tone language with a complex interrelation between (a) pitch height, (b) voice quality of the vowel, and (c) vowel length. Baima has three contrastive tones, which in a prepausal position all end in a falling pitch contour. ... Baima morphemes (lexical and grammatical) are generally monosyllabic, but words are generally disyllabic. Polysyllabic words are mostly composite, formed through compounding. Content morphemes in Baima are specified for lexical tone ... In connected speech, grammatical morphemes are prosodically weak, they usually have shorter duration than content morphemes and no fixed tone value ... In polysyllabic words, each syllable bears its own (etymological) tone (correlated with a specific phonation type). In Proceedings of the Eighth Workshop on the Use of Computational Methods in the Study of Endangered Languages (ComputEL-8), Honolulu, 170-181. ACL Anthology 2025.computel-main.20. HAL hal-05395424.
tone_statements.quote: Chirkova et al. (2023) suggest that Baima lexical tones are distinguished not only by fundamental frequency (f0) contours but also by differences in phonation type. According to their analysis, the high falling tone (â) is produced with “tense” phonation, the mid-level tone (ā) with modal phonation, and the low rising tone (à) with breathy or lax phonation. ... The data confirm a consistent three-way lexical tone contrast across all speakers, aligning with the system proposed by Chirkova et al. (2023).

tone_statements.summary: Three lexical tones (high falling/tense, mid level/modal, low rising/lax) confirmed by f0 + EGG open quotient on 9 speakers; authors call it a register-tone system. Nothing on TBU or stress.

tone.quote: The Baima language (/pekeᴴ/, Chinese 白马语 báimǎyǔ, ISO-639 code bqh) is a little-studied Tibeto-Burman (Bodic or Himalayish) language spoken in the southwestern part of the People’s Republic of China. ... The largest concentrations of Baima speakers are in Báimǎ Township (白马乡, Baima /topuᴴ/) of Píngwǔ County, and in Tiělóu Township (铁楼乡) of Wénxiàn County.
